rules.prepare:
# As in Debian's rules: macros that gettext has newer ones of go away, and # gtkdocize is not called, gtk-doc is not there. cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" grep -rl gettext-0.20 m4/ | xargs rm -f GTKDOCIZE="echo DISABLED running gtkdocize" autoreconf -vfi bh_autotools_dev_update
# The options of Debian's rules, with these differences: no DANE, which # needs unbound, and no NLS. The C++ library is not built, Debian builds it # and leaves it out of its packages. The compression libraries and TPM are # not there when Debian builds the package, here they may be. cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure" \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --sysconfdir=/etc \ --enable-ld-version-script \ --enable-static \ --disable-cxx \ --disable-doc \ --disable-gtk-doc \ --disable-libdane \ --disable-nls \ --disable-rpath \ --disable-silent-rules \ --disable-tests \ --without-brotli \ --without-tpm \ --without-tpm2 \ --without-zlib \ --without-zstd \ --with-default-trust-store-file=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
